contract.acquisition: one captured lifecycle graph and the full commit trees from that graph
contract.verification: per-commit component scopes, opaque location IDs and current verdicts retained
contract.lifecycle: separate private logical fingerprint; companion changes and current invalid verdicts do not create detector removals
contract.prefilter: candidate observations use the same logical identity; filtering is not evidence of deletion
contract.output: existing GitTimeline schema and basis retained; private Item/Finding lifecycle identities have json exclusion and finalizer clears private finding key
contract.post_intake_limits: detector/timeline limits can follow already valid provider requests; partial results inhibit baseline and negative lifecycle claims

local.network: OS deny-network except localhost; owned Git and HTTP fixtures only

repository.network: OS deny-network except localhost; owned Git and HTTP fixtures only

source_unit_cases: one graph across complete commit trees; separate locations/scopes
shared lifecycle with distinct revision evidence
scoped pre-filter observation prevents false removal

performance.scope: default per-item GOROOT pipeline; Git acquisition/verification workload not benchmarked
performance.competing_validation_jobs: none during paired samples; ordinary background host services remained running
